base_ledger.primary_reference_scope: Six sagittal coordinates; not seventeen independently validated joint targets
base_ledger.route_scope: Muscle paths can create off-sagittal torques; route coverage or NMF43-muscle representation does not establish closed-loop rank or independent control
base_ledger.passive_scope: Joint/contact/passive-muscle actions are mechanical contributions,not neural PF controllers
base_ledger.apparatus_scope: Existing runs retain horizontal/rotational guides; zero prescribed vertical support does not imply free balance. Soft guides do not remove anatomical DoFs.
base_ledger.source_conversion_scope: Observed native105-coordinate model has82 auxiliary follower coordinates in addition to23 anatomical coordinates; native count is not anatomical DoF count
base_ledger.static_span_scope: Parent audit: source92/represented86 local activation torque rank17; frozen bilateral K6 activation basis rank12 at4walking poses. This excludes extra reflex/posture channels and proves neither cone feasibility nor closed-loop control.

mono_rule_matrix.scope: NEW sagittal-mono subset only. All group currents are independent per type/postsynaptic cell; budgets across types add. Noncentral/local reflexes unchanged. No contralateral route, extensorIa universal sign, biarticular integration, or independent3D PF claim.

rule_inheritance.F_Ia_II: Local replication shinohara_rules.json shin2025_eq10 target set RG-F/IN-F/PF-F supports positive flexor velocity/length feedback. Actual bounded SNSIa/II encoding differs from its v^0.6 and90%-length equations; no copied paper gain or exact replication.
rule_inheritance.E_Ib: Local replication shin2025_eq11 target set RG-E/IN-E/PF-E supports positive extensor force feedback. Human mono roles are an explicit engineering adaptation.
rule_inheritance.E_II: Local neuroscience same-group typeII rule plus specified EII central extension; NOT attributed to Shinoharaeq11 force formula.
rule_inheritance.implementation: New engineering gains from independent current budgets, actual PF support and declared roles. No extensorIa universal sign, reflex-state reversal, biarticular integration or historical-dissertation repair claimed.

mono_rule_matrix.compiled_graph_policy: Actual dense/sparse runtime is authority; original builder drawing is a baseline and must not be relabelled as the augmented graph

mechanism_scope: New direct excitatory centralIb routes are NOT phase/load-gated IBEXC MN outputs; both mechanisms coexist. ExtensorII is an engineering extension. No new biarticular circuit,4-cell change,fullmuscle or3D closure.
